## Objectives

1. Defeat 60 [Saltdead Stump](../monsters/saltdead_stump.md) in [The Greystrand](../maps/drowned_strand.md)
2. Bring 15 [Salt-Killed Bark](../items/salt_killed_bark.md) (taken)
3. Talk to [Elspeth](../npcs/elspeth_healer.md)

## Rewards

- 31,000 EXP
- 2,000 mesos
- +40 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Brigid](../npcs/brigid_herbs.md)
